title: Cache returns stale prices after a deploy (fixture: failed dossier)
scenario: dossier-fail: the full dossier produced no fence, the case job failed, and the escape hatch grades the skill

skills.name: fx-dossier-fail-skill
skills.description: Use when a read-through cache serves stale values after a deploy; checks whether the cache key includes the schema version.
skills.body:
# Diagnose stale cache reads

## Steps
1. Check whether the cache key includes the schema or build version.
2. Compare the TTL with the deploy cadence.

messages.content: Prices shown to customers were stale for an hour after the deploy. Why?

I loaded the fx-dossier-fail-skill skill and followed its first step. The price cache key omits the schema version, so after the deploy the new code read entries written by the old code until the 60-minute TTL expired.

findings.summary: The price cache key omits the schema version, so post-deploy reads hit entries written by the previous build until the TTL expires.

dossier.text: The model rambled and produced no fence.
